value.text: Implemented the approved static core descriptor contract and single app descriptor+runner registry. Actual cargo run --bin unisphere -- adapters list --json exited0 and emitted only claude-code with symbolic home/.claude/projects, native jsonl and truthful Unix/OTLP/caller-owned append-only cursor fields. Real terminal default human rendering was observed; explicit human, piped JSON, JSON help and human invalid-argument paths were exercised. Two app registry/provenance tests and three real-process integration cases passed, including hostile environment byte identity, inaccessible store roots and safe correctly labelled errors. A throwaway external frontend consumer proved write/flush failures return1 without leaking I/O text; its source/result is retained in catalog-io-smoke.json and its directory was removed. Existing CLI/adapters docs updated, including the deliberate JSON-error stream difference from sessions. No additional adapters, dependencies, private scans or persisted resume were added. Exact committed-candidate quality and independent composition review remain next.
